semantics.clock: All state changes occur on the positive edge of clk.
semantics.reset: Active-low synchronous reset: when resetn is 0 at a positive edge, all four stages become 0. Reset changes between positive edges do not change state.
semantics.transition: When resetn is 1 at a positive edge: stage0_next=in, stage1_next=stage0, stage2_next=stage1, stage3_next=stage2, using pre-edge values.
semantics.output: out continuously equals stage3. An input sampled at edge k reaches out immediately after edge k+3, traversing four D flops.
semantics.initialization: No specified power-up initialization; state is unspecified until a synchronous reset or sufficient input shifts.
semantics.throughput: One bit sampled on each non-reset positive edge; no enable or handshake.

numeric.data: One-bit unsigned bit values, preserved without arithmetic.
numeric.arithmetic: No rounding, saturation, overflow, or signed arithmetic applies.

verification.oracle: Independent four-entry history model updated at each positive edge; compare out to the oldest stored bit after nonblocking assignments settle.
verification.directed: Check reset clearing, isolated impulse four-stage propagation, all-zero/all-one runs and alternating inputs.
verification.exhaustive: For every possible four-bit input pattern, reset then shift each bit and flush zeros while checking each edge.
verification.reset_timing: Assert and deassert reset between edges while out is high, verify no immediate change, then verify clearing at a positive edge. Test reset during activity and consecutive reset edges.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts; preserve logs.

specification_ambiguities: Reset value is not explicitly stated; interpret resettable D flops as clearing all stages to zero.
Power-up values are unspecified and no initialization is added.
